quote: Submerged with target bearing 187°T range 20000 yards.
Target obscured by heavy rain. Wind and sea were force 4-5. ... Planed up to radar depth but there was no pip.
Surfaced in a heavy downpour of rain.
Sighted target coming out of rain ... Submerged.
Went to 120 feet and for 25 minutes ran at full speed 8 knots heading for a 120° port track.
Came to periscope depth and slowed.
Surfaced and commenced end-around.
Submerged to 150 feet and for 45 minutes ran at standard speed 6 knots on course 070°T
Came to periscope depth and slowed. ... With a nearly flat battery and no more time available decided to accept an unfavorable position
Surfaced ran normal to direction of new station until target was out of sight
Sighted unidentified plane 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 1.) Submerged. Periscope patrol.
Surfaced.
Sighted two unidentified planes 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 2.) Submerged.
Surfaced 15 minutes later.
Sighted two unidentified planes 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 3.) Submerged.
Surfaced 20 minutes later.
Sighted four unidentified planes 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 4.) Submerged.
Surfaced 30 minutes later.
Sighted one unidentified plane 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 5.) Submerged.
Surfaced 15 minutes later.
Sighted two unidentified planes 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 6.) Submerged.
Surfaced 25 minutes later.
Sighted one unidentified plane 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 7.) Submerged.
Surfaced 20 minutes later.
Sighted one unidentified plane 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 8.) Submerged.
Surfaced 20 minutes later.
Sighted two medium bombers 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 9.) Submerged.
Surfaced. Set course for new station.
Sighted two SBD's ... (Plane Contact No. 10.) Submerged at 0815 when they had closed to about 8 miles.
Surfaced.
Sighted two SBD's 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 14.) Planes heading toward us. Submerged.
Surfaced 15 minutes later.
Sighted one SBD 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 15.) Plane headed toward us. Submerged.
Surfaced 35 minutes later.
Sighted unidentified plane in dim twilight range 1 mile. (Plane Contact No. 16.) Submerged.
Heard two distant depth charges.
Surfaced.
Sighted two unidentified planes 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 17.) Submerged.
Surfaced 25 minutes later.
Sighted one unidentified plane 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 18.) Submerged.
Surfaced 15 minutes later.
Sighted one SBD 8 miles. (Plane Contact No. 19.) Submerged.
Surfaced one hour later.
Submerged for morning twilight to avoid plane detection.
Surfaced at 0634.
Sighted two SBD's 8 miles. (Plane Contact No. 20.) Submerged. High periscope patrol.
Surfaced.
Sighted tops of ships ... Submerged and commenced approach.
Definitely identified ships as U.S. Task Force ... at 3000 yards was detected by a destroyer. Went to 250 feet and exchanged recognition signals. (time not stated; between 1200 and 1345)
Commenced periscope depth patrol.
Surfaced.
Sighted one unidentified plane 10-12 miles. (Plane Contact No. 23.) Submerged. Periscope depth patrol.
Surfaced.
At 0530 submerged; range had decreased to 5500 yards and visibility was now less than 1000 yards.
At 250 feet exchanged recognition signals with friendly destroyer.
Surfaced.
Sighted unidentified plane 8-10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 29.) Submerged. Conducting submerged patrol in area.
Surfaced.
Submerged.
Surfaced.
Effected rendezvous with SEAHORSE and GROWLER. Commenced coordinated patrol. Submerged in daylight surface at night. (routine applies until 1944-07-17)
Closed direction until submerging at 0550.
Submerged - range 21000 yards.
Surfaced and commenced end-around.
Sighted MAVIS type plane 10 miles. (Plane Contact No. 32.) Submerged.
went to 200 feet and ran for 45 minutes at standard speed (6.5 knots) ... Sea was flat calm
commenced firing four bow torpedoes at second ship in west column range 1750 yards
saw second MARU in east column firing what looked like 20 m.m. tracers at us ... range 600 yards so ordered 450 feet.
The first depth charge close but above us as we passed 200 feet

A sustained depth charge attack totalling 125 charges started six minutes after the attack. Ran at standard speed for ten minutes then evaded on steady course at 2/3 speed at 500 feet. We were under a 16° negative temperature gradient.
After reloading at 400 feet with no depth charges for an hour and a half
and only weak pinging astern planed up to periscope depth.
Saw two CHIDORI torpedo boats ... range 14000 yards. They dropped 17 depth charges at 1937
Surfaced and set course to station for patrol with SEAHORSE.
Surfaced to investigate possible smoke.
Submerged. False contact; clouds.
Surfaced due to reduced visibility.
Submerged visibility normal.
On surface. Received contact report from SEAHORSE (time surfaced not stated)
Fired three torpedoes gyro angle 0° angle on the bow 0°. Submerged immediately after firing.
No explosion at 50 seconds so ordered 450 feet and rigged for depth charge.
While passing 350 feet first of series of about 20 depth charges. Many of these were quite close but resulted in no serious damage.
At periscope depth nothing in sight.
Heard distant depth charging.
Surfaced and commenced search.
Sighted plane (Plane Contact No. 33) coming in distance 6 miles. Submerged.
Continued approach at 200 feet making standard speed.
Heard pinging and fast screws. Went to 400 feet.
First of series of about 20 depth charges. Some of these were very close
before I went to 500 feet. They could evidently contact me at 400 but not 500 feet. Continued approach on freighter at 500 feet
At periscope depth sighted freighter angle on the bow 15° port range 9000 yards.
Saw two planes over target (Plane Contact No. 34) ... Went deep. (depth not stated; 500 ft inferred from 'Back to 500 feet' at 1708)
Started planing up for look at about 1650.
Received one depth charge very close. Back to 500 feet.
Surfaced 90 miles southeast of Hongkong.
Surfaced due to reduced visibility.
Submerged. Visibility normal.
Surfaced.
Surfaced due to impossibility of maintaining depth control in tide rips (see Section (D) - Tidal Information).
Out of tide rips submerged.
Submerged on plane contact (Plane Contact No. 35) distance one mile. Overcast and dark
One depth bomb not close.
Surfaced due to tide rips and reduced visibility.
Submerged.
Surfaced due to reduced visibility.
Submerged.
Submerged. SD radar contact distance 7 miles. (Plane Contact No. 37.)
While submerged sighted periscope about 3000 yards distance believed to be SAWFISH ... ran at 250 feet for one hour at 2/3 speed.
(back to periscope depth after one hour; time inferred)
Sighted two planes. (Plane Contact No. 40) distance 8 miles. Submerged. Periscope depth patrol.
Surfaced.
